description: This file defines the BmiService class which provides BMI calculation, storage, and retrieval functionalities in a wellness monitoring system.

classes.name: BmiService
classes.description: Provides methods to calculate BMI, save BMI records, retrieve trends, and get the latest BMI record.

methods.name: calculateBmi
methods.description: Calculates BMI using weight in kilograms and height in centimeters.

methods.name: saveRecord
methods.description: Saves a BMI record with specified weight, height, and date.

methods.name: trend
methods.description: Retrieves BMI records within a specified date range.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent BMI record.
